_comment: Example SFX catalog. Keys = filenames (without .mp3). Underscore-prefixed keys ignored. duration in seconds. generate_sfx.py reads this.

ui_click.prompt: short soft UI button click, clean, dry, no reverb

coin_pickup.prompt: bright coin pickup chime, arcade, satisfying

hit_impact.prompt: punchy impact thud, dull, game hit

explosion.prompt: short arcade explosion, punchy low end, no music

level_win.prompt: triumphant short victory fanfare sting, bright

ambient_wind.prompt: soft looping wind ambience, calm, outdoors
